title: Al-Malik: The Quran Calls Ten Other People King Before It Ends on This Name
excerpt: The word malik occurs fifteen times in the Quran, not the 150-plus you will often see quoted. Five name God. The other ten are human kings — including a queen's warning about what kings do to a town.
seo_title: Al-Malik: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Malik, the King, appears 15 times in the Quran — 5 of God and 10 of human rulers. Why the common count of 152 is wrong, and where the five divine uses sit.
